text:
jenna: FYI — we got a flood of 401 spikes starting ~21:08 UTC in support alerts. Looks correlated with the scheduled auth-key rotation that closed ~21:05. Several tenants reporting API failures.

matt: seeing same in logs. errors from authn-service token-verify path. throwing 401s for tokens that previously validated.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-279876 — authn-service unexpected 401 surge (rotation window). Auto-page sent to oncall.

jenna: customers affected include a few Dedicated tenants and some Hosted API customers (high-volume). Billing not impacted so far, but they're getting timeouts/401s.

support_lead: started triage with support. Collecting request IDs and sample request headers. Need quick containment — any immediate mitigations? :rotating_light:

matt: initial suspicion: rotation-controller completed key publish but key-distributor/backfill job never finished for some edge nodes. fallback to old key failed because grace flag ended at rotation commit. I can confirm missing new key in KV on ~10% of auth pods.

ops-robin: what does `kubectl` show for key-backfill job?

matt: ran:
```
kubectl -n infra get jobs | grep key-backfill
NAME                     COMPLETIONS   DURATION
key-backfill-20260317    0/10          00:12
```
so backfill crashed mid-run (OOM on a worker).

jenna: oh — recall we removed retry-from-start behavior in backfill v2 to speed window. that might explain crash + partial propagation.

matt: mitigation plan: 1) re-enable grace fallback (re-open old key acceptance), 2) scale key-backfill job workers to avoid OOM, 3) revert rotation flag so active tokens use old key until backfill completes. I'm prepping commands.

sre-oncall-bot: Running automated rollback checklist (step 1/4).

matt: issuing rollback now: `rotation-controller rollback --rotation-id=2026-03-17-rotate-8 --force`

ops-robin: applied rollback, re-enabled `authn.allow_legacy_key` via feature-flag-store. Pushing rollout to edge pools.

qa-nina: seeing drop in 401 rate in our canary tenant. I'll keep watch. :white_check_mark:

support_lead: Support is notifying impacted customers with the short note: "We've detected an authentication disruption following a key rotation. We've rolled back the change and are monitoring — no action required on your side." Draft in #customer-notify once you confirm stability.

matt: backfill restarted with higher memory, now showing progress: `key-backfill-20260317 6/10` — should finish in ~7m.

jenna: good. please capture logs and the OOM stack for postmortem. We need to revert the change that removed retries and add batching safeguards.

ops-robin: logged the worker OOM traces to S3: s3://infra-logs/key-backfill/2026-03-17/oom-trace.log and opened ticket INFRA-438.

matt: creating postmortem draft after stable: root cause = premature rollback of legacy acceptance + backfill worker OOM causing partial key propagation -> tokens validated against keyset with missing entries -> 401s. Secondary cause = config change to backfill retry semantics.

support_lead: timeline to customers: we should prepare an update at +45m with final status and ETA for full verification. assign me to customer comms.

jenna: agreed. tagging incident owners: @matt (eng-runtime) for fix, @ops-robin for infra changes, @qa-nina for verification, @support_lead for comms. We'll keep this thread for updates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
